+	}

+func (ma *MachineAddresses) Scan(destination interface{}) error {
+	switch value := destination.(type) {
+	case string:
+		addresses := strings.Split(value, ",")

+		for _, addr := range addresses {
+			if len(addr) < 1 {
+				continue
+			}
+			parsed, err := netaddr.ParseIP(addr)
+			if err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			*ma = append(*ma, parsed)
+		}
+
+		return nil
+

+	}
